verdict.rationale: BVNK documents registrable webhooks: HTTP POSTs to a URL you provide for events such as pay-ins and payouts. It also documents signature validation and a specific channel-transaction-confirmed event, which covers signed payment-confirmation notifications. Conversion-executed events are not evidenced, and payout settlement is covered only by a generic mention of payouts. Missing for 10: a documented conversion/transfer-executed webhook event, a specific payout-settled event schema, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, money movement emits signed webhooks — payment confirmed, payout settled, conversion executed — so my system tracks state without polling chains or dashboards

citations.quote: When something happens in your BVNK account, such as a pay-in or a payout, the platform sends an HTTP POST request to a URL you provide with the event details in real time.
The BVNK Webhook Signature Validator is a client-side tool that helps developers verify webhook signatures from BVNK's payment processing system.
Compare your generated signatures against signatures received from BVNK.
